scenario: [LEXP.4.2] a NaN Float is rejected at the assert ingress (DS_ERR_NAN_REJECTED, -216). NaN must never enter working memory: NaN != NaN, so it never self-matches and would corrupt no-op-reassert identity ([LFAC.2]), beta joins, and refraction. This completes the rule the engine already half-follows (NaN-producing ops like sqrt of a negative and division-by-zero already error). Inf is a *valid* value (its data-plane hard error and ±Inf text form are [LDET.3.2.7]); only NaN is rejected, and the nan constant is reserved-not-usable. The harness asserts a NaN Float slot and expects the fault to carry code -216 and mention NaN.

schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    x: Float mutable

rule touch:
    Reading
->
    log info "r"
